questions.q: 3. 有無參考強度、姿勢或構圖控制參數？
questions.answer: MCP soul_2 只有 quality、style_id、soul_id、1 張參考圖、比例；沒有參考強度、姿勢、構圖、seed、negative 參數。官方說明頁也沒有強度設定。後台任務紀錄有 style_strength 1、Soul 參考 strength 1 等欄位，但 MCP 無法設定，能否調整未確認。其他工具：nano_banana_2 有 mask＋is_inpaint（限制只改遮罩區）；outpaint_image 只有比例與寬高，沒有方向或錨點參數；Nano Banana 系列官方寫可放最多 14 張參考、在 prompt 說明每張的用途。
questions.status: Soul 沒有強度／姿勢／構圖參數：已確認；後台強度可否調整：未確認

questions.q: 5. 官方有無身分保持能力與限制的說明？
questions.answer: 有。官方 Soul ID 頁：「the same face appears across every generation, regardless of style, pose, or lighting」；限制：「Expect "clearly the same person" rather than a pixel-identical face」、「extreme style shifts or unusual angles can introduce small drift」、一個 Soul ID 只放一人；並寫「A reference image anchors a single generation but drifts across many separate ones」、訓練建議 20 張以上（最多 80）、訓練好的 Soul 會自動出現在 Elements。身材是否保持官方沒寫：未確認。Somi 的 Soul 名稱標示以 5 張訓練，少於官方建議；這點對全身小臉的影響未確認。Somi Soul 是否已出現在本工作區 Elements：未確認（本輪沒列 Elements）。
questions.status: 官方說明存在：已確認；身材保持、Somi Soul 在 Elements 的可用性：未確認

step1.source_rights: 本帳號生成，官方說明：輸出歸使用者、可商用；不含任何真人照片
step1.prompt: A photograph of a quiet hot-spring town lane at blue hour in gentle snowfall, seen at eye level from across the lane, with natural perspective. Top of the picture: snow-laden wooden eaves and a strip of deep-blue evening sky. Middle: the lane recedes to the left between old dark-timber inns with closed wooden lattice doors; a few small plain paper lanterns glow under the eaves, getting smaller into the distance. Bottom third: smooth fresh snow covering the lane, untouched in the foreground. A young Korean woman with honey-orange brown hair in a layered wolf cut, wearing a long deep-cranberry wool coat over an ivory knit mini dress and white knee-high boots, walks slowly from right to left along the lane with her hands in her coat pockets, glancing up at the falling snow, her face in three-quarter view. She is a modest figure a little right of centre, with the lane opening out ahead of her; her whole body is visible, both boots stand on the snow, and a wide stretch of snow lies between her boots and the bottom of the picture. The nearest lantern casts a warm amber pool of light on her and on the snow around her; everything else stays cool blue. It is a quiet pedestrian lane: plain timber walls, lattice doors, lanterns and snow are all there is.

acceptance_step1: 1. 照片填滿整個畫面，沒有白邊、相紙框、頁面或文字版面
2. 雙靴完整、靴下有可見雪地，沒有貼到下緣
3. 人與巷道共同構圖：巷道、屋簷與燈籠的退縮線條是畫面的一部分，不只是背景（看圖判斷，人物高度只記錄）
4. 沒有招牌文字、電線、車輛、桶子等雜物
5. 姿態讀得出慢走中抬頭看雪的瞬間，不是對鏡頭擺姿勢
6. 藍調＋近處燈籠暖光圈，酒紅／象牙白／白靴配色
acceptance_step2: 1–6 與底稿相同，且沒有比底稿變差
7. 臉是 Somi（對照 identity_master.jpg），成年，沒有替身臉混入
8. 服裝正確：深蔓越莓紅大衣、象牙白針織迷你洋裝、白色及膝長靴
